device_name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU

field_preview.description: Real part of the port 1 device electric phasor on the central Ez grid plane.

phase: Physical exp(-i omega t), +Ey at x-normal ports and +Ex at y-normal ports for both directions. Reflection reference subtracted. Propagation phase retained.
scope: Fundamental quasi-TE submatrix of a fixed-height lossless oxide-clad silicon extrusion with cardinal ports. Uncollected power includes radiation, other modes and numerical error.

tidy3d.scope: Bound fundamental transverse mode of two perpendicular straight leads. Tidy3D is set up independently but FDTDX also calls Tidy3D internally; MPB uses a separate plane-wave eigensolver.

mesh_diagnostic.scope: A mesh-trend estimate for lead effective index only. The held-out 128-cell sample tests the trend.

mpb.scope: Bound fundamental transverse mode of two perpendicular straight leads. Tidy3D is set up independently but FDTDX also calls Tidy3D internally; MPB uses a separate plane-wave eigensolver.

mesh_diagnostic.scope: A mesh-trend estimate for lead effective index only. The held-out 128-cell sample tests the trend.

native_frame_check.study: FDTDX signed transverse source and reciprocal-overlap checks
native_frame_check.scope: Native CPU cross-section eigensolves and projections only. Whole-device spectra and time evolution use separately injected NVIDIA fields.

ansys_lumerical_reference.kind: published Lumerical MODE curved-mode loss and straight-to-bend overlap estimate
ansys_lumerical_reference.scope: Published circular bend and two straight/bent mode junctions. The Workbench default is an abrupt polygon elbow. The published loss estimate has a different geometry and observable.

dependency_updates.change: The grating helper gained a memory query. The layout worker uses its original cache salt and hardware fingerprint routines.

worker_compatibility.change: Only GPU coordination lock selection changed within the layout worker. Numerical functions and settings match the captured source. Any separate dependency additions are listed.

material_sampling: Eight by eight lateral quadrature points per Yee component cell, exact slab thickness overlap. Ex/Ey use arithmetic volume mixing. Ez uses harmonic mixing across the flat vertical interface and an arithmetic lateral area average.
qualification: All published matrices were reconstructed from native E/H phasors and signed reciprocal overlaps. Mesh and reference-plane differences are reported separately.
